I spent some amount of time looking at this today and then neglected to
get to posting about it until now.

It appears to me that most of the downtown Indianapolis hotels do
already have their blocks of rooms reserved for GenCon (and therefore
not available to the general public) during the GenCon dates. For some,
it is possible to book rooms starting the Sunday before (I was looking
at Sun 15 August checkin to Sun 22 August checkout), but the rates are
either very high throughout or go very high (like $200+ per night) when
GenCon starts.

I'm not sure what the best solution is; I don't know how feasible it is
to book through the convention and then also book at the same hotel for
the Sunday-Thursday leading up to GenCon. It could be tricky (at least
for keeping the same room, if that matters much) since the hotels aren't
going to have all of GenCon's reservation information downloaded until
about a week before the con starts.

All that said, since hotel booking does start Monday, I think we should
probably all start booking rooms at one particular hotel on Monday for
GenCon, and then work out the run-up portion as we can.

I don't really have a preference as to which one, though - I think they
are all similarly priced (around $130 a night plus tax?) for the ones
immediately adjacent to the convention center. I stayed at the
Indianapolis Marriott Downtown last year; the New Yorkers stayed at the
Westin; those were both nice places. The Embassy Suites has free
parking (which most do not, although there were non-hotel surface lots
near the Convention Center that were fairly inexpensive) but is probably
a little farther away. Anyone want to nominate one? I would be willing
to defer to Nick and go with the Westin; it is definitely *very*
conveniently located. :-)

You can see the list here, if you want to check out the available Con
hotels:

http://www.gencon.com/displayindy.aspx?file=indy-housing

Josh

Okay, I am shortly about to book at the Comfort Inn and Suites City

right about that. But I seem to be able to book for the Sunday-Monday
nights through Comfort Inn's own website (night of 8/15 and 8/16) at

night but it should be all good after that.

I will now selfishly suggest that everyone else book at the Comfort Inn
and Suites City Centre as well, because it's pretty cheap ($130 for 4)
and would be convenient for me. :-) Also, if you are a person who
believes I am destined to organize your arrangements, you are probably

luck. Don't wait until August to do it though, I'm expecting "my" rooms

Josh
